options: The category of regular period (such as Month, Week, or Quarter) a calendar's periods are built from
A chart of accounts segment qualifier
A currency conversion rate type
A legal entity's registration category
questions.explain: Period type describes the kind of regular period, like Month or Week, that every regular period in a given calendar shares.

questions.q: What is an adjusting period used for?
options: Recording ordinary day-to-day operating transactions
Recording entries like year-end audit adjustments and final true-ups, kept separate from regular operating period balances
Replacing the fiscal year entirely
Storing a business unit's reference data set
questions.explain: Adjusting periods isolate audit adjustments and closing true-ups from normal operating activity, rather than mixing them into a regular period.

questions.q: How many adjusting periods does a typical company calendar define?
options: A new adjusting period for every journal entry
Exactly twelve, one per month
Usually just one, positioned at fiscal year-end
Adjusting periods are never used in practice
questions.explain: Most companies define a single adjusting period at year-end, since that's when audit adjustments are most commonly needed; a few may define more for specific business reasons.

questions.q: Why can some reports include adjusting period activity while others exclude it?
options: Adjusting periods can never appear in any report
Only secondary ledgers can have adjusting periods
Oracle Fusion does not support this flexibility at all
Because different reports answer different questions — pre-audit, regular-period numbers versus full, audited final numbers
questions.explain: Reports and balance inquiries can include or exclude adjusting period activity depending on whether pre-audit or fully audited numbers are needed.

questions.q: What is a risk of defining more adjusting periods than a company actually needs?
options: There is no downside; more adjusting periods are always better
Extra adjusting periods add unnecessary complexity to maintain
Extra adjusting periods automatically merge with regular periods
They are not permitted by Oracle Fusion at all
questions.explain: As with other enterprise structure choices in this course, adding more adjusting periods than genuinely needed increases ongoing maintenance complexity.
